messages:
marta: quick follow-up from the missing-spans postmortem — scheduling a short checkpoint to confirm remediations and owners. recap: missing spans due to sampler config drift, aggregator double-count for 0.7% of traces, ETL lag spikes during midnight window. who can confirm ownership for each remediations?

dom: I can own sampler config drift. plan is to pin sampler config in chart and add admission webhook validation. ETA next Tue for PR.

lee: taking aggregator correction. will add invariant checks and a nightly sanity job. target end of week for first pass.

sylvia: I'll own the ETL lag follow-up — investigating shard imbalance and backpressure in kafka consumer. small mitigation (consumer parallelism bump) today, deeper fix next sprint.

jordan: +1 on owners. can we add tracked tickets so we can show progress in the postmortem?

marta: yes — please create tickets in the observability board and tag with PM:analytics and label:postmortem-fix. we'll use the followup meeting on Thu 14:00 PT to check blockers.

dom: created ticket OBS-1423 for sampler pin + webhook. description: "Pin sampler config in helm values, add admission validation, e2e test to prevent drift". link: https://issues.internal/OBS-1423 :thumbsup:

lee: created OBS-1424 for aggregator checks + nightly job. added owner: lee, reviewers: dom, sylvia.

sylvia: OBS-1425 for ETL shard rebalance experiment and consumer tuning. put current mitigation as step 0.

oncall-bot: Reminder: incident runbook snapshot taken at 2405123600. runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/observability-missing-spans

jordan: can we add a metric for "spans-lost-rate" and an alert if >0.1% over 15m? that'll catch regressions earlier.

marta: agreed. dom can you add the metric query and alert in OBS-1423?

dom: yes. plan: add metric, grafana panel, and a pager rule with a low-severity threshold. will post query here once ready.

lee: quick note — when I ran the aggregation sanity job locally I found a bucket edge-case where TTL causes duplicate counting. I'll add mitigation to OBS-1424 and a snippet for tests.

marta: great. for tracking: please update ticket status by Wed EOD. if any blocker, escalate in this thread.

sylvia: putting a short mitigation in prod now (consumer parallelism + rebalance). monitor logs, will report in 20m.

oncall-bot: deploy started by sylvia at 2405124200. Command: ```kubectl -n analytics rollout restart deploy etl-consumer```

lee: re: CI — adding a synthetic trace generator to catch aggregation drift in PR checks. snippet: ```python
# synthetic trace generator
for i in range(1000):
    send_trace(sampled=True, spans=rand_spans())
```

jordan: if the nightly sanity job and the new alert both pass for 3 days, we can close the postmortem follow-up and move to standard monitoring. propose review date: 3 business days after fixes merged.

marta: noted. calendar invite to Thu 14:00 PT sent. agenda: quick status, blockers, close criteria. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
